translations.translatedText: # Saturday 22.8.2020 (radio)
The Russian opposition leader is in Germany. President Niinistö's discussions. Poor-quality masks and respirators. World Overshoot Day. Rainy weather continues.
## Navalny is in hospital in Germany
![Alexei Navalny was taken to a hospital in Berlin.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11506862)
Open image viewer
There are many guards outside the hospital. Alexei Navalny is in this hospital. Photo: Clemens Bilan / EPA
The Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny is now in a hospital in Berlin, Germany. He was moved from Russia to Germany this morning.
German doctors have not yet said what has happened to Navalny. He became seriously ill on Thursday. Navalny's assistant claims that he was poisoned.
The opposition leader Alexei Navalny is the best-known opponent of President Vladimir Putin in Russia.
## President Niinistö had an influence

![Sauli Niinistö at the Yle premises in Pasila in May 2020.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4000,h_2250,x_0,y_419/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7108195f3ff1b3a5224/1598026281)
Open image viewer
President Niinistö spoke today on Yle's Ykkösaamu programme on television. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
Finland's President Sauli Niinistö says that he actively discussed the situation of the Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny with other heads of state yesterday.
Niinistö says that he spoke with German Chancellor Angela Merkel. They agreed that the opposition leader should be moved from Russia to Germany.
After this, Niinistö spoke with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Putin said that the move is fine. Niinistö therefore had an important role in the events.
## Poor-quality masks and respirators
![An empty shelf in a shop.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11479029)
Open image viewer
The mask shelf in this shop is completely empty. Authorities warn that poor-quality masks are also being sold in Finland. Photo: Antti Aimo-Koivisto / Lehtikuva

The Regional State Administrative Agency warns that poor-quality face masks and respirators are also being sold in Finland. They do not meet the requirements. In some products the marking has been forged.
The authorities are now banning the advertising of poor-quality products.
For example, Chinese KN95 masks are being advertised in Finland. Selling them to people is illegal.
## World Overshoot Day is today
![A picture of Brussels Airlines aircraft at the airport near Brussels.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11424266)
Open image viewer
Corona has reduced flying. That is why a lot of oil, which is an important natural resource, has been saved. Photo: Stephanie Lecocq / EPA
Today is World Overshoot Day. It means that people have now used up all the natural resources that the Earth produces in a year.
In this matter the coronavirus pandemic has been helpful. Because of the corona, Overshoot Day is three weeks later this year than it was last year.
The bad news is that we would need 1.6 Earths if we continue to use natural resources at the same rate.
For example, using oil as fuel reduces natural resources. Oil is a fossil fuel, and no more of it is formed.
## Rainy weather continues

![Thunderstorm, thunder flashes. A lightning strike, storm clouds in a dark sky. Lightning. Turku.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4752,h_2671,x_0,y_356/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/17-68195582b125c48d59/1501761257)
Open image viewer
There may be thunder during the night and tomorrow daytime. Photo: Pekka Parviainen / Yle
The weather continues rainy.
During the night there may be strong thunderstorms in the south and east of the country, and a lot of rain may fall.
Tomorrow, on Sunday, there will be thunder and rain in the east and in the north.
In the south it is partly sunny.
Power cuts may happen because of the thunder.
